title: eludite.browser.network input
description: Read a tab's network requests, oldest first: method, url, status, resource type, MIME type, timing, size, failure and initiator. Pass the answer's `next` as `since` to read only newer requests; `dropped` counts requests lost because the tab keeps the last 5000. Filter by `url_pattern`, `status` or `resource_type`. Use to find failed API calls (4xx, 5xx, `failed`) after an action. A request still in flight has no status yet. Response bodies are not included. Fails with "no tab" when the browser has no tab: call eludite.browser.tab_open first.

since.description: Answer requests after this cursor (default 0: from the oldest kept).

url_pattern.description: Only requests whose url matches. A substring, or a regular expression between slashes (`/err(or)?/`; Rust regex syntax, `/.../i` for case-insensitive).

status.description: Only responses with this HTTP status.

resource_type.description: Only this resource type, as CDP names it (Document, Stylesheet, Image, Media, Font, Script, XHR, Fetch, WebSocket, Other, ...), case-insensitive.

tab.description: The tab: its id from eludite.browser.tabs (`t1`, `t2`, ...). Default: the active tab (the one last opened or selected).
